verdict.rationale: The evidence shows conventional analytics, not AI-generated insights. The dashboard provides metrics (requests, tokens, cost) and request logs, and the docs mention 'gain insight on requests and errors', but nothing documents the product itself using AI to analyze your data and surface insights or suggestions. Dashboard analytics are an adjacent feature and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
